reason: I'm a freelancer paying out of my own pocket, and $30/month is a recurring charge for a tool I'd open a few times a week. I hunt deals and jump to free tiers, so a seat fee feels like money down the drain when I'm solo and don't even have a team to share sessions with.
objection: $30/seat adds up fast, and as a solo developer I don't have 10+ agents or teammates to split it with — I'd rather stitch together free tiers than commit to a subscription.
would_change_my_mind: A permanent free tier for solo developers.
